# documentation-actions

> Reusable GitHub Actions and workflows for Docusaurus docs sites and awesome-list repositories.
> Optimized for AI coding agents.

## Start here (new sites)

Copy `examples/docs-suite.yml` and call `reusable-docs-suite.yml@v2`.
It wires docs-ci + optional pages deploy + optional hygiene checks in one call.

## Quick decision tree

| Goal | Prefer |
|------|--------|
| New site (recommended) | examples/docs-suite.yml |
| Full docs CI only | examples/docs-ci.yml |
| PR build only | reusable-test-deploy |
| Pages deploy | reusable-pages-deploy |
| README sync | reusable-readme-sync |
| Docs sync feedback (label + comment) | reusable-sync-feedback |
| Label conflicts | reusable-label-conflicts |
| PR report | reusable-pr-report |

## Core rules

1. Copy from examples/.
2. Prefer short names. Pin `@v2`.
3. Pin third-party Actions to full SHA.
4. Triggers + permissions stay on the caller.
5. Append-only index. Changelog fragments only.
6. Line length ≤ 140.
7. Do not merge unless asked.

## Key files

- docs/docs-suite.md
- docs/naming.md
- docs/v2-release.md
- AGENTS.md
- examples/
